summary: British artillery officer and Theosophist Percy Fawcett surveyed Bolivian borders, inflated his exploits, shot an Indigenous man and covered it up, then vanished in Brazil in 1925 with his son while seeking an occult lost city.

evidence.note: Birth in Torquay in 1867 and family background
Teenage posting in Ceylon, Buddhist mysticism and treasure dig
Brother Edward's Theosophy, work on The Secret Doctrine and Buddhist conversion
Long segment on cricket and schools as training for imperial service
1906 RGS commission to survey Bolivian borders starts main span
Racist descriptions of Indigenous people and concealed shooting of a man
WWI counter-battery post on the Western Front using a Ouija board
Psychic reading of the idol frames Z as Atlantis remnant
1925 final expedition with Jack and Raleigh Rimell; disappearance
Modern LIDAR findings and reappraisal of his lost-city theory

notes: Occult-esoteric is nearly co-equal with exploration as the pitch; chose science-exploration as primary. FR placed for the WWI Western Front segment (exact sector not stated). Morocco spy mission and Malta/Hong Kong postings were brief, so excluded. Grann's 2009 book and the 2016 film are critiqued throughout but treated as reappraisal (reaches_present), not covered years.
